result.instructions: Tools for BrewMan, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders are open for delivery this week?"; "Show me the current stock level of our kegged beers by location."; "List the lines of order 1b2c3d4e-... and cancel it with the reason 'customer closed'.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes BrewMan data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run brewman_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run brewman_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run brewman_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. brewman_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: brewman_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Return the BrewMan user that the Api-Token belongs to, with its tenant group id. Use it to confirm the connection. BrewMan API: POST /webapi/User/v1/GetCurrentUserContext.

tools.name: brewman_list_outlets
tools.title: List outlets
tools.description: List all outlets (customers: pubs, shops, accounts) in the tenant. Use the outlet ids with the order tools. BrewMan API: POST /webapi/Outlet/v1/GetAllOutlets.

tools.name: brewman_get_outlet
tools.title: Get an outlet
tools.description: Get one outlet by id, with its contact, address, price list and credit terms. BrewMan API: POST /webapi/Outlet/v1/GetOutlet.

tools.name: brewman_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List full orders (header and lines) that match a filter. Dates are inclusive yyyy-mm-dd. Results can be large: set filter.maximumResults. BrewMan API: POST /webapi/Order/v2/GetOrdersByFilter.

filter.description: Order filter. All fields are optional.

maximumResults.description: Maximum number of results to return.

outletIds.description: Only orders for these outlet ids.

tools.name: brewman_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order by id, with its header and lines. BrewMan API: POST /webapi/Order/v2/GetOrder.

tools.name: brewman_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List items (products, materials, services) that match a filter. Use the item ids with stock and order tools. BrewMan API: POST /webapi/Item/v1/GetItemsByFilter.

filter.description: Item filter. All fields are optional.

maximumResults.description: Maximum number of results to return.

productBrandIds.description: Only items of these product brands.

stockGroupIds.description: Only items in these stock groups.

tools.name: brewman_get_stock_levels
tools.title: Get stock levels
tools.description: Get the current stock level (all batches summed) per stock item and stock location. Narrow it with the id lists. BrewMan API: POST /webapi/Stock/v1/GetStockItemsQuantityCurrentlyInStock.

stock_location_ids.description: Only these stock locations (from the stock location list).

tools.name: brewman_get_stock_incoming_outgoing
tools.title: Get incoming and outgoing stock
tools.description: Get the known incoming and outgoing stock totals (on purchase orders, allocated to orders, in transfers) for items and locations. BrewMan API: POST /webapi/Stock/v1/GetStockIncomingOutgoing.

stock_location_ids.description: Stock location ids to report on.

tools.name: brewman_list_price_lists
tools.title: List price lists
tools.description: List all price lists with their currency and whether they use gross pricing. Use the ids when you create an order. BrewMan API: POST /webapi/PriceList/v1/GetAllPriceLists.

tools.name: brewman_list_purchase_orders
tools.title: List purchase orders
tools.description: List purchase orders that match a filter (status, supplier, dates). Dates are inclusive yyyy-mm-dd. BrewMan API: POST /webapi/PurchaseOrder/v1/GetPurchaseOrdersByFilter.

filter.description: Purchase order filter. All fields are optional.

maximumResults.description: Maximum number of results to return.

statuses.description: Only purchase orders in these statuses.

supplierIds.description: Only purchase orders with these suppliers.

tools.name: brewman_create_order
tools.title: Create an order
tools.description: Create a new order for an outlet, in Open status. Then add lines with brewman_add_order_line. Writes to the BrewMan tenant. BrewMan API: POST /webapi/Order/v1/CreateOrder.

outlet_id.description: The outlet the order is for. Required; it cannot be changed later.

duty_return_date_override.description: Special duty return date, only when needed.

standard_order_type.description: Duty and price type of the order.

external_reference.description: Reference of the order in the source system. Cannot be changed later.

tools.name: brewman_add_order_line
tools.title: Add a line to an order
tools.description: Add a stock item line to an open order. Pass a new GUID as order_line_id for each line. Writes to the BrewMan tenant. BrewMan API: POST /webapi/Order/v1/AddLineToOrder.

order_id.description: The order to add the line to (from brewman_create_order or brewman_list_orders).

order_line_id.description: A new GUID for the line. Generate one for each new line.

stock_location_id.description: The stock location the line is taken from.

stock_item_id.description: The stock item (item id) to add.

quantity.description: Quantity to add, in the unit of measure.

unit_of_measure_id.description: Unit of measure id of the quantity.

urn.description: Optional URN text of the line, sent as given.

annotations.title: Add a line to an order

tools.name: brewman_delete_order_lines
tools.title: Delete order lines
tools.description: Delete one or more lines from an order. This cannot be undone through the API. BrewMan API: POST /webapi/Order/v1/DeleteLinesFromOrder.

order_header_id.description: The order id the lines belong to.

line_ids.description: The ids of the lines to delete.

tools.name: brewman_cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel an order
tools.description: Cancel an order and give the reason. A cancelled order cannot be reopened through the API. BrewMan API: POST /webapi/Order/v1/CancelOrder.

cancellation_reason.description: Why the order is cancelled. BrewMan records it.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with BrewMan
prompts.description: What you can do with BrewMan here, with example requests to try.
